summary: Implemented registration profile persistence and Google consent gating for iteration `registration-profile-consent`. Added nullable `User.firstName` and `User.lastName` fields plus migration, registration pages/actions that validate and store transient first/last names, and Auth.js callback logic that preserves existing Google logins while blocking first-time Google registration until explicit consent is present. Rejected Google consent clears transient registration state and redirects unauthenticated to sign-in. Verification run: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0` passed; `npx.cmd prisma validate` passed; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false` passed; `npm.cmd run lint` passed; `npm.cmd run build` passed; `node --test .ai_factory/tests/unit/registration/registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs` passed with 4/4 tests. Browser verification was not run and remains pending per task constraints. Note: plain `npx.cmd prisma generate` failed once with `EPERM: operation not permitted, rename ... query_engine-windows.dll.node.tmp15312 -> ... query_engine-windows.dll.node`; `npx.cmd prisma generate --no-engine` then completed successfully to refresh Prisma client metadata without touching the locked engine file.
